title: Leaks like CRAZY
text: Leaks like CRAZY. Keeps things hot for a reasonably long time, but this thing leaks like crazy unless you screw it in "just so" - and you don't realize that it's not on exactly right until it's already leaked and you have liquid all over your chest. Still looking for the perfect tea thermos - this isn't it.

product_metadata.title: The Tea Spot Mountain Tea Tumbler - Travel Bottle with Tea Infuser for Loose Leaf Tea or Iced Coffee - 16oz, Sunset Red - Sleek Double-Walled Insulated Bottle - Keeps Drinks Hot and Cold for Hours
features: Rugged Yet Beautiful: A coffee or tea maker and tumbler all in one. The Mountain is a 16-oz insulated stainless steel tumbler that boasts a large ultra-fine tea infuser inside a sleek double-walled vacuum sealed body. Keep your drinks hot for 6 hours and cold for 12 hours.
Keep Your Tea Fresh for Hours: Take your tea on any adventure with this rugged stainless steel tea tumbler. Iced or hot, its double-walled insulation will keep your tea fresh for hours.

Brew On the Go: Our tea and coffee tumbler features a stainless steel infuser basket that can be used for brewing hot or iced tea or iced coffee. The infuser basket may be removed after brewing is complete or left inside when used as a cold brew bottle.
10% Pledge On Your Purchase: 10% of all sales are donated to community wellness programs. The Tea Spot is a woman-owned Certified B-Corp with a commitment to health and wellness.
We're Here for You: We love our tea and coffee accessories, and we hope you do too. If you're not satisfied with your purchase, please feel free to reach out so we can take care of it for you.
